name: Muviz
description: A Jetpack compose app that consumes the TMDB API to display movie and Tv shows and their details

issues.title: Disable Detele Button On Favorites Screen

latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* migrate from Material 2 to Material 3 by @joelkanyi in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/83
* Theme options by @joelkanyi in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/84
* fix films and search pagination by @joelkanyi in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/85
* update to kotlin 2.0.0 by @joelkanyi in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/87
* migrate to compose destinations v2 by @joelkanyi in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/88
* add shared element transitions by @joelkanyi in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/89
* update dependency com.google.devtools.ksp from 2.0.0-1.0.21 to v2.0.0-1.0.22 by @renovate in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/90
* update gradle/wrapper-validation-action action from v2 to v3 by @renovate in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/80
* update all non-major dependencies by @renovate in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/78
* update main branch and some dependencies by @joelkanyi in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/91
* move search screen to bottom navigation bar by @joelkanyi in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/95

## New Contributors
* @tenSunFree made their first contribution in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/30
* @renovate made their first contribution in https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/pull/44

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/joelkanyi/Muviz/commits/1.0.5
